stanza: Over the ground lies a mantle of white
A heaven of diamond shine down through the night
Two hearts are thrilling in spite of the chill in the weather
Romance can blossom any old time

q.line: And in a way I'm hoping
q.linePrev: And I think my head is glowing
q.lineNext: To be done with all this weighing up of truth
